what: exp118 arm A: every interval of exp117's runs recomputed by a second route written from the specification alone, set beside exp/out/exp117_e2e/<run>.json
readings: W_h for sizes from weights is N_h / sum of N_h, with N_h the rounded sum of the stratum's weights.

The average over every distinct order is the expectation over a uniformly random permutation of the labels (each distinct order arises from the same number of permutations); computed exactly by a recursion over counts.
Sums over strata (V, A_k, W_sum) run over sampled strata only; W_u is the share of the strata file's strata that hold no label.
The lower end is located by bisection to a bracket of 1e-15 and the bracket's lower point (where the condition holds) is returned.
A difference's estimate and normal theory are those of d = right_a - right_b as a linear quantity (sum W_h dbar_h); this equals 2 theta_x - 1 when W_u = 0.

A ratio with an empty denominator (no label mapped as, or referenced as, the class) has no estimate and no normal-theory interval; its box takes 0 for an empty lower denominator and 1 for an empty upper one.
The box is clipped to [0, 1] after the 0/1 rule for empty denominators.

Pure-stratum rule: stratum o's k is its labels that are right (map equals reference or alternate); the mixed strata are all sampled strata declared pure for no class (including those where the class has no label); strata declared pure for another class are left out of the sums; the rule needs exactly one declared stratum for the class, the first map, finite whole-unit sizes and no unsampled stratum. Its estimate and normal theory are the ratio estimator's.
Hypergeometric tails are compared with a strict '>' at (1 - conf) / 2, conf computed as the specification writes it.
Classes are the union over maps of each map's classes and its reference classes by the rule, plus every class key of exp117's output.
A point with an unreadable code in the reference or in any map is dropped from the whole run (counted).
nlcd2016_8_alt: an alternate code outside the crosswalk counts as no alternate.

notes.sizes: areas from the strata file, a point frame with unit area 1 (N_lo = floor(area))

their_design.frame: units of 1 drawn without replacement, read as points in an area
